newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS puts CanOxy on credit watch.
newsitem.headline: CBRS puts CanOxy on credit watch.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Wednesday it placed its ratings for Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd debt on credit watch with developing implications following the company's announcement of a C$2-billion takeover bid for Wascana Energy Inc.
CBRS said the credit watch would include CanOxy's A-1 rated commercial paper program and A rated debentures.

In a friendly proposal, CanOxy has offered C$20.50 cash for each Wascana share. The deal would be financed through additional bank borrowings which would have material effects on the consolidated debt leverage position of the company, CBRS said.

CBRS said it was scheduled to meet shortly with CanOxy's senior management to discuss the financing required to fund the deal and whether the credit quality of the company's outstanding debt would be effected.
Wascana's debt was already under review following an earlier offer for the company from Talisman Energy Inc.
